newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle market not tested - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle market not tested - USDA.

text.p: Trade was inactive in the Panhandle area early Monday, USDA said.

Slaughter steers and heifers were not tested. Feedlots reporting moderate inquiry from buyers. The last established price was $66.00 on last Thursday. Monday's packer bids are $65.00, with asking prices $67.00-$68.00.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink. Confirmed - None
